auth.label: API Key
auth.description: ablefy API key sent as the key query parameter. Generate it under Settings > Integrations > ablefyAPI in your ablefy account: https://app.ablefy.io/.

extraFields.label: API Secret
extraFields.description: ablefy API secret sent as the secret query parameter. Generate it together with the API key under Settings > Integrations > ablefyAPI: https://app.ablefy.io/.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get the ablefy account associated with the configured API credentials.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require any input.

data.description: The JSON response returned by ablefy.

actions.name: get_pricing_plan
actions.description: Get one ablefy pricing plan by its numeric identifier.

id.description: The numeric ablefy pricing plan identifier.

data.description: The JSON response returned by ablefy.

outputSchema.description: The requested ablefy pricing plan response.

actions.name: get_product
actions.description: Get an ablefy product and its related pricing and author information.

data.description: The JSON response returned by ablefy.

actions.name: list_pricing_plans
actions.description: List pricing plans available in the connected ablefy account.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require any input.

data.description: The JSON response returned by ablefy.

outputSchema.description: The ablefy pricing plan collection response.

actions.name: list_products
actions.description: List products available in the connected ablefy account.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require any input.

data.description: The JSON response returned by ablefy.
